dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: I'd love nothing more! I'm not sure if you know this, but I do enjoy a good chat. Not that I have as many friends to chat with as I'd like — it's not easy when you have to keep up the pretense of being mysterious and dignified.

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: What would you like to talk about?

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: Astronomy, geography, bad-mouthing Alice... I'm an expert on all sorts of topics.

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: Haha, I was only joking. How could I possibly talk bad of her behind her back?

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: This is a principle Anya taught me about how to conduct myself. Even if you're trying to be diplomatic and get along with everyone, you have to set limits.

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: The bottom line is, you should never betray your friends — even if it's only taking a few minor verbal swings when they're not around.

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: Alright, alright... Don't look at me like that, it's not like I'm afraid of her. Let me just think of something she won't mind me sharing.

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: The introductory magic that Alice designed for Rhinedottir used a ton of different templates. The whole thing is an affront to aesthetics.

choices.text: Tell me something you normally couldn't...

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: That's a fantastic idea! This realm may well be cut off entirely from the outside world. Anything that's said within is probably impervious to prying ears.

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: However, a powerful retracing spell might still prove effective. For instance, if you mentioned a revised version of history in here, you wouldn't be able to remember anything upon leaving. In other words, there would be no loophole to exploit.

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: It may seem somewhat abstract, but that abstraction is necessary to ensure the rigor of the design.

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: I still think it's safer not to talk about such things. But... since it's you, maybe it's fine.
